Ok, normally I would not leave a review for a game, it's not my style, and I am a horrible writer, but I just have to say this.
If you have put over 500 hours into the game, it should get a positive review, even if it costs 60 dollars unless the game seriously screwed you over.

That being said, a lot of people in the "negative reviews" section are complaining about the game changing for the worse, and that theres no "end game" guess what, there doesn't NEED to be an end game, if you've played for long enough in a FREE, let me repeat that FREE GAME, to reach where the "end game" should be, you got your money out of it. If you buy something from the game, you chose to buy it, in my experience I have never seen anything in the game that you HAD to buy to get it from the developers, you can always grind until you get it. and if you want it enough to buy it with real money, you should want it enough to grind a few dozen hours. if you don't wanna grind, buy it, I wont judge you, I really couldn't care less whether you bought every single warframe and mod you own. if you feel that more should be added to the game, suggest stuff to the developers, maybe they can give you another COMPLETELY FREE update, or patch. Yes, they're not the best at working on the more important issues, but remind me, how many successful free games have you made lately. 
Sorry for preaching, that needed to be said for the people with 1k+ hours and complaining their MHMS off, If you don't like the game anymore, feel free to leave a no on the reccomended, but don't whine about the games "golden days" if you liked it better then, just remember your sweet memories. my only personal complaint is the "power creep" as people call it. each new weapon/frame is stronger than the last one, making the old fun weapons obsolete. nidus for example can deal up to 30k+ damage without ANY mods at all with his first ability, that not only costs 40 energy to cast, but restores 1/4th of the energy used to cast it, and people call him balanced. Again, sorry for preaching. have a nice day

If you see anything here saying pay 2 win don't worry about it, it's not.  Let me tell you why. This game is all about the grind. Everthing is obtainable through grinding for it. So what happens when you buy the items that you want?  You skipped the grind which in turn cut a bunch of content for yourself which might make future grinds easier but you have effectivly less content and sure this game has a pvp mode but hardly anyone plays it for that its more of a side thing.  Looking around online and seeing people complain about this bugs me.  If you don't want a endless grind of a shooter where you'll never run out of stuff to do whether its getting your new weapon or getting them to sell to other users to earn plat for slots or to get that last piece of your weapon that seems unobtainable don't download this game but its a free game so why not try it?  The game is fun and a controller is highly recommended hope this helped and have fun!

[h1]WARFRAME 2013[/h1]
I played Warframe when it was in Beta. Over 300 hours of game time and it was fun! Lots o' fun. Played it so much I burned out and moved onto other games. As time passed and talking to friends that still played WF, their comment was, "you are not going to recognize it."

[h1]WARFRAME 2017[/h1]
Holy Smokes! Things have changed! Digital Extremes really stuck to their guns and put everything into WF and didn't stop.

The start of the game begins like DC Universe. I cringed at that thought until the story pulled it self into Warframe and Wow! What a blast! The core of WF gameplay is still there, but the over all world of WF has changed for the better. Much better! 

I'm very happy with what has become of WF and highly recommend if you are looking for an online shooter that may be played Co-op or solo. Either way WF is a great game! Check it out!
